title: Triplicate
alt: Four panels in the teal office. Margo, behind her desk, reads out Case 4471: one silver earring, last seen Tuesday; a silver hoop earring lies on the desk. Pip, a small lavender candle-ghost, says it's in her coat and they could just put it there. In a close-up, Margo, deadpan, says they could and asks if the form is done; from the edge of the panel Pip holds out three signed sheets, white, yellow and pink, and says 'Signed. Dated. Triplicate.' Pip stamps the form with a CHUNK and asks who keeps the third one. Finally Margo, standing at her desk with a pink sheet and a small tin beside her, says 'Someone who might come looking.'
hover: Margo's drawer already has a lot of third copies.
transcript: Panel 1 – MARGO: Case 4471. One earring, silver. Last seen Tuesday.
Panel 1 – PIP: It's in her coat. We could just put it there.
Panel 2 – MARGO: We could. Is the form done?
Panel 3 – PIP: Who keeps the third one?
Panel 4 – MARGO: Someone who might come looking.
note: The earring was in the coat the whole time. That's not the point of the case. It's the point of the form.
